# Hostile test log

Seventeen standard-library tests pass. They cover:

- rational pi, exponential, sine, and square-root primitives;
- derivative orders zero through eight;
- Bell-polynomial low-order identities;
- positivity floor and contractive omitted-image ratios;
- monotone tail behavior at three heat times;
- invalid time and excessive-order rejection;
- identity and cut-locus inequalities;
- complete formula-adaptive three-chart coverage;
- character/image overlap;
- certificate round-trip and tamper detection.
